bullets.content: [general] Change ONE factor per solve (h, a refinement size, or a target), never two, so compare() can attribute the change. Use all 4 solves; after each, run compare() against the baseline before choosing. Never change h and refinements together (repeated g0→g1).

[general] After solve 1 call view(kind=error); read top-5 hotspots (face/edge, local h vs requested). If delivered h >1.3x requested inside a box, the box is too thin or small: enlarge its extent or switch to a volume box, don't shrink size or grow radius.

[general] Meshing is deterministic: never re-solve a known recipe (e.g. 2.13564e-4 at 5705 nodes). Use all 4 solves on new levers or a reference, each tested against the control. Note candidate and finest solve numbers before compare(). Diffs ~0.06 are remeshing noise.

[general] Check min_quality on every mesh call. Coarse h (>=0.008) around small boxes gave 0.128 here and 0.078 for a5 at h 0.0095. Remesh with radius >=0.006 or smaller h before solving if it nears 0.1.
[general] Use free mesh() calls to price a recipe before solving. Spend solves on distinct levers (+y corner box, point at worst hidden point), not near-duplicate meshes.

[general] After solve 1 read the full hotspot list and view error from z and iso. Spend the single-factor solve on the top-share hotspot whose local h is >1.5x the finest box size (e.g. #4 at h 0.0052), not on a layer already fine.
[general] The SUBMITTED mesh must differ from your previous submission in at least one deliberate factor. Resubmitting g5 froze base at 0.763 while peers' variants reached 0.784-0.787.
[general] Never resubmit last generation's exact mesh: identical meshes tie on check points (zero bonus) and add no information. Spend every solve on new recipes.
[general] Pick by score, not accuracy. Below 2x the score is (g/2)^2/c (c = DOFs/6057), so a 40% DOF cut is worth up to ~29% more error. Estimate error from compare vs finest and hotspot shares.
[general] Strain energy is a cheap convergence proxy: compare your first solve's energy with peers' at similar DOFs (a box run 2.130e-4 vs edge run 2.121e-4) before investing more solves.

[general] Spend one solve on a x0.75 reference (all sizes and h x0.75, ~30k DOFs). Estimate e≈1.3×compare(candidate, ref) and rank by e·DOFs. Energy-deficit guesses without a reference were inconsistent.
[general] Submitting the cheapest of near-identical solves was right: the 26.8k reference differed from the 17k candidate by only ~7%, so extra DOFs cost more than they gain.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Variant role: a14 g6 recipe (5277 nodes, energy 2.13341e-4, e·DOFs 1351). Change only radii, first f7 r0.006->0.003. Do not resubmit 5277/5274/5705 node meshes (ties pay nothing; within 1% is the same mesh).

[abc_00000065_bc0] Box radii are often ignored: upper r0.004/0.007/0.012 all gave 5705 nodes, bottom r0.005/0.007 identical, tier1 r0.003->0.006 identical. Price radius changes with mesh(); if nodes unchanged, don't solve. If f7 r0.003 is no effect, price f7 r0.0045/0.009, then all bottom radii together.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Control baseline (g5 rank 1): h0.008 o2, bottom box zmax -0.0066, f7 0.0035, upper 0.0038: 5705 nodes, 17115 DOFs, field 8.15%, points 8.06%, e·DOFs 1395, base 0.763. Deterministic: solve 1 must reproduce energy 2.1356e-4. Change one factor only.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Clamp-box thickness is dead: zmax -0.0066->-0.0063 gave +2.2% DOFs, same energy (2.13543 vs 2.13564e-4). Clamp layer z≈-0.0072 stays 3.4-4.6% VM at h 0.0025-0.0028. Bottom box radius not a lever. Stop tuning it and the upper box size.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Upper box ladder 0.0045/0.0038/0.0032: 16.5k/17.1k/18.4k DOFs, energy 2.1322/2.1356/2.1367e-4. 0.0038 is the sweet spot; stop tuning it.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Highlight a12: best base 0.775 (e·DOFs 1372) at 15.8k DOFs, a2-family: tier1 0.0018, tier2 and band 0.003, upper 0.0043. Denser ±y band coverage beat single box.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Plan: S1 a14 recipe f7 r0.003; S2 f7 r0.009; S3 x0.75 reference (h0.006, sizes x0.75); S4 better radius direction pushed (r0.002/0.012) or a14 control. Compare each with S3; never compare against a solve you won't submit.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Stop edge grading at clamp band: edge18 0.0018 r0.008 left hotspot #1 (16% energy) at h0.0036; edge22 0.0013 reached 0.0028-0.0032. Boxes reach 0.0022-0.0026 at fewer DOFs. Radius 0.008->0.012 added 900 DOFs for noise; not a lever.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Keep f7 at 0.0035 r0.006 (touching h <=0.0035). f7 0.004 gave touching 0.00416; f7-side hotspots #2/#3 (22% of error) sat at h 0.0036-0.0038.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Avoid full-thickness boxes z -0.0081..0.0081 at 0.0045; mid-thickness has little error. Split: fine bottom refinement z<-0.0066 and upper wall box from z -0.003 up at 0.0045.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Keep wide y coverage: box y -0.027..0.024 cut point RMS 11.2%->5.58% and won hidden-point bonus. Points no longer bind (field 9.54% does). Spend DOFs where error energy is. If f38/f4 touching h >0.005, +y corner band (y 0.015-0.02) is under-covered.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Do not use h0.011: small faces f26-f32/f34 mesh at 0.0029-0.0031, f10/f11 0.0033 (vs 0.0041-0.0045 at h0.008). Use h0.008 or price both with mesh() and keep lower node count.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Hotspots #1-#3,#5 (~30% of error) at z≈-0.007, 0.4-1 mm off f5/f7, h 0.0025-0.003, only 3-5% VM: diminishing returns going finer; spend DOFs on +y corner and upper bore wall.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Upper bore wall near f5 z~+0.0066 holds 3.8-4% at h0.0047-0.0052. If field stays >8.5%, try upper box 0.0038 r0.004 over x 0.012-0.025.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Worst hidden points: 19.9% near f5 (-0.005,-0.0245,0.002) h~0.0045; 11.5% near f13 (-0.015,-0.0375,0.006). Try point refinement 0.003 r0.005 (cheap, hidden-point bonus). Cell (0.0253,-0.0115,0.006) shows 150% local error: check f5 top.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Control recipe: h0.011, edge22 0.0022 r0.004, edge18 0.003, f7 0.004 gave 11.7% at 15.2k DOFs. Change one factor per solve.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Min quality ~0.11 at h0.008/0.011 with small boxes, near 0.1 limit. Keep radii >=0.004-0.005 and check quality before solving.
[abc_00000065_bc0] The h0.008 recipe is converged (x0.75 reference differs 7%). Next solve must test a new lever, not a near-duplicate; price variants with free mesh() first.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Field 8.15% and points 8.06% nearly tie; any field gain below ~8% makes points bind. Check the low-stress -y region (f13 h 0.0055, f52 0.0073) isn't where error moved. Choose by e·DOFs, e~N^-0.43.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Solves 3-4 (~18k DOFs) gave energy 2.1367e-4 vs 2.1322e-4, compare 3-6% noise. Submitting the cheapest was right; extra DOFs not worth it.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Calibration from x0.75 reference (8948 nodes, 2.14423e-4): field error ≈1.16×compare(candidate, ref). Rank by compare×DOFs; <0.3% compare is noise. Base=1063/(e·DOFs) above target; accept a radius change if compare×DOFs drops ≥1% vs a14 control.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Setup verified: 3d, fixed f12, pressure 2.1e6 Pa on f7, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, order 2 only (P1 ~6-7% too stiff). Reuse verbatim.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Use all 4 solves, view(kind=error) after solve 1. Plan: S1 new recipe (h0.0065 explorer), S2 one factor at top hotspot, S3 cheaper or finer bracket, S4 best combination; compare finest against each. Baseline (16.1%, 26841 DOFs) is the known control; do not resubmit it.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Next mesh call: mesh(h=0.0065, order=2, refinements=[f2 0.0025 r0.005, edge39 0.002 r0.005, edge8 0.002 r0.005, points (±0.013,±0.010,0.0245) size 0.003 r0.006 at the four saddle lobes]). Expect 16-19k DOFs, ~17-19% field error, base ~0.27-0.30 (estimate).
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] After the h0.0065 call require min_quality >=0.1 and folded_cells 0. If nodes exceed 6700 (~20k DOFs) shrink point radii to 0.004. Keep f19/f16 touching h <=0.004.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Saddle hotspots #1/#2/#3/#6 (12.2% of error, 15-18% vM) at (±0.013,±0.010,0.023-0.026), 2 mm off f20/f10/f9, h 0.0041-0.0047. Edges 39/8 don't reach them (even r0.008 left h 0.0043). Target with points or a box.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] a11's saddle box [-0.016,-0.014,0.022,0.016,0.014,0.03] at 0.0028 cut saddle h 0.0044->0.00375 and field error 16.1->15.7% for +2k DOFs. Saddle responds; points at four lobes should be cheaper.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Cost is binding: baseline spends ~4800 elements on f20/f23 at h0.004, including lower wall z<0.018 (~2% per cell). Coarsen global h; keep fine sizes only at boss roots, saddle and clamp ring.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Copy a3's DOF discipline: h0.012 with body box 0.0058, edges 39/8 0.0025, f2 0.003, edge 40 0.003 gave 15.5k DOFs, 20.7% error, best base 0.233. +70% DOFs bought only 20.7->16.1%.
